title: Compounding Wins
hook: Posting every day for a year beats one viral week. It just doesn't feel like it in month two.
statement: Small consistent actions beat rare heroic ones.
explainer: Consistent effort stacks on itself. Big bursts don't. And every time you break the streak, you lose more than that one day. You lose the compounding.
sop: Pick one action that builds on itself, like content, savings, or relationships.
Set your Base, Rate, and Time for it.
Commit to the smallest daily version you'll never skip.
Track the streak somewhere you can't ignore.
equation_example: Base of 100 email subscribers, Rate 5% a month, Time 12 months. 100 × 1.05 to the 12th power = about 180. Higher Rate or longer Time and it really takes off. Break the streak and the growth resets.
question: Name one small thing you've been inconsistent with and the smallest daily version you'd keep.
closing_statement: Small and steady outlasts rare and heroic.
caption:
Principle Nº 107: Compounding Wins

Posting every day for a year beats one viral week. It just doesn't feel like it in month two.

Small consistent actions beat rare heroic ones.

Your turn: Name one small thing you've been inconsistent with and the smallest daily version you'd keep.
